title: overlay-r3: 124 PS3 sound banks converted to the PS4 SCREAM format (sound-banks/convert_banks.py)
notes: bnkconv.py rewrites SBlk v4/v5 big-endian to SBlk v13 (rules re-derived 2026-11-05; envelope table adsr_env.json and its nearest-pair fallback are the original 2026-10-27 converter's). MP3 (codec 3) and PCM16 samples are re-encoded by vagenc.py, an exact pure-Python port of the original vagenc.c (third_party/vagenc-oct27-src). MP3 is decoded with ffmpeg (-f mp3 -i pipe:0 -f s16le -ac 1 -ar <rate> pipe:1, data read from sample+0x80 for the header data size, trimmed to the header sample count). Verified 2026-11-05 with ffmpeg 8.1.1 (msys2 clang64; the original used 6.1.1-3ubuntu5): all 124 banks byte-identical. Without ffmpeg the 95 banks with MP3 samples are skipped with a message. Pure Python, about 29 min with 6 worker processes.
